basis: a composite with no single widget role: Reka color parts render role="slider" thumbs, a text input and a role="listbox" swatch picker on one labelled surface — the root contract is the group.

exceptions.because: color-picker.e2e.ts presses the picker's real keyboard surface in browser — the thumbs stepping their announced values under the arrows, the hex field committing on Enter, the preset listbox walking real focus between swatches and choosing on Enter — while keeping focus through a thumb step is exactly what the interaction-level defect below leaves unproven; the keyboard family's own rules (aria-hidden-focus and its siblings) are the harness axe gate's to answer; the role-axis evidence tranche owns un-qualifying this row
e2e/focus-not-obscured.e2e.ts (WCAG 2.4.11) covers three pages today — button, dialog, drawer; this page joins when that suite's population grows (tracked in ecoma-io/loom#432)

interaction.basis: swatches, sliders and field inputs managed as one selection state.

harness.because: witnesses the value halves — the thumbs stepping their announced values, the hex committing on Enter, the swatch walk choosing on Enter — while keeping focus through a step stays unproven

exceptions.because: an arrow step on either thumb moves the value but not only the value: the preset listbox is bound to the picker's shared model, and reka's listbox re-highlights on any change made outside itself — by focusing the selected swatch — so one ArrowRight on the saturation or hue thumb ends with focus on a swatch and the walk hijacked (observed in the harness; the ListboxRoot model watcher verified against the pinned reka-ui dist); tracked in ecoma-io/loom#432
